name: monster-tactics
description: A browser-based tower-defense game built with Phaser 3, in the style of Bloons TD 6: enemies march along a fixed winding path, you place monsters off the path to attack anything that comes into range, and you build your collection through a gacha-style Monster Sanctuary instead of a shop. Also has an early Multiplayer World beta - a shared map players walk around together with live previews of each other's bases.
